description: Read-only. Returns a link to a page on objelio.de where the user can subscribe to e-mail alerts for these criteria: new matching listings and price reductions, at most one e-mail a day, unsubscribe with one click. Pass the same criteria as in search_listings (at least one, e.g. a location). The user enters the e-mail address on that page and confirms it by e-mail; do not ask for it in the chat. Nothing is saved until the user does so.

criteria.description: Structured search criteria, as in search_listings.

features_preferred.description: Nice-to-have features, only affect the order.

features_required.description: Must-have features. Listings without information stay in the results as unknown.

living_area_min_qm.description: Minimum living area in square meters.

locations.description: Several locations mean any of them. With umkreis_km, listings around the place are found and each result has entfernung_km.

ort.description: Town or city, e.g. Paderborn. Also matches district names.

ortsteil.description: District, e.g. Schloß Neuhaus. Ignored with umkreis_km.

plz.description: German postal code or its beginning, e.g. 33104 or 331.

umkreis_km.description: Radius in km around ort or a five-digit plz, for requests like "within 20 km of Bielefeld" or "near Paderborn" (use 10 km when no number is given). Covers all of Germany.

notes_unmapped.description: Wishes that fit no field (e.g. quiet location). They do not filter and are shown back to the user.

offer_type.description: "kauf" (buy) or "miete" (rent). Currently almost all listings are for sale.

property_subtypes.description: Only if the user explicitly names a subtype, e.g. doppelhaushaelfte (semi-detached house), reihenhaus, penthouse.

rooms_min.description: Minimum number of rooms (German count, kitchen and bath excluded).

year_built_min.description: Built in or after this year.

name: get_search_alert_link

kriterien.description: The saved criteria in German words.

link.description: Page on objelio.de where the user enters an e-mail address and confirms it. Show it to the user.

title: Get search alert link
